_comment: WorkerService Base Configuration - Production defaults. Inherits from Configuration/shared/appsettings.defaults.json. Filesystem-first with Azure Storage optional. Downstream sync DISABLED by default (enable in Development or Production configs).

DownstreamConfiguration._comment: Production: Disabled by default. WorkerService syncs directly from Microsoft Update. Enable for branch office/downstream scenarios by setting SyncFromUpstream=true and UpstreamFunctionsUrl.
